title: 第十章 火长常舒欣
slug: 盛唐风华全本免费-盛唐风华最新章节列表
content_zh:
被徐乐一脚踢散的火堆，正在山顶各处零星燃动，火光映照进来，映得树林中或躺或站的大隋右屯卫恒安府鹰扬兵们脸色一片煞白。
韩约厚重结实的身形肃立场中，这些与突厥人都见过阵的鹰扬兵们竟无一人敢于上前。
谁也没想到，打劫一个商队居然踢到铁板！
河东边地，是民风强悍，出了颇多侠少。可是比之军中手段，却还有差距。更不用说恒安鹰扬府是出名的精锐，和突厥人见阵也不落下风。
更不用说他们一火中人以有心算无心，行事也算谨慎，等着这商队入睡之后才悄悄摸上来。
就是突厥狼骑一个小队，易地而处，说不得都要在他们手里吃亏。
可偏偏这支商队，不仅早早的发现了他们的动静，而且还有这么一个可怕的人物。岁数不大，铁牌舞动纯然是军中手段，还高明得出奇。就是入恒安鹰扬府中，刘鹰击说不得都要重用，中垒营中少不了一个队正的位置。
这种人物，来行什么商！
这火长胸中转着念头，按着剧痛的胸口，再度开口：“你们不是突厥哨探？咱们是奉刘鹰击和苑校尉号令，伏路山中，截杀突厥哨探……你们到底是什么人？”
这火长，心思之活，在恒安鹰扬府中也是出名的。人的心思一活，临阵之际偷奸耍滑保命求生，什么样的念头都来了。再加上私心颇重，对军纪也就那么回事。所以虽然是跟着刘武周的老班底，却始终也没升上去，现下还只是一个火长。
刚才一声喊侥幸保住了性命，看来是鹰扬兵的身份镇住了人。这火长随口就给他们突袭安了个正大光明的理由，背上一边淌着冷汗，一边用言辞吓住眼前这个持铁牌的杀神。
他麾下弟兄，也是和他一般气味相投的，私下里也不知道一起做了多少干犯军纪的事情。火长口风一转，当下人人都明白过来，一起附和。
“你这汉子，不是突厥哨探，说一声就是，还冲进来打个什么？”
“要不是咱们手下有准，发现不对，发箭的时候抬了抬手，你们那里的人就得伤几个！”
“咱们一番好心，你倒是下手毫不容情！现下伤了几个，你说说这帐到底如何算法？”
韩约立在场中，拿着铁牌，一脸不知所措的模样。
厮杀之际韩约猛如疯虎，现在被这些兵痞一挤兑，当真是一句话也说不出来。适才这些人发箭，准准的都中铁牌，要不是自家遮护得宜，现在就该躺在这里了，怎么也不像有留手的样子啊。
可这些人毕竟是恒安府的鹰扬兵！
这个时候就听见徐乐的声音响起，似乎还带着笑意：“你们真是恒安府的鹰扬兵？伏路查探突厥人哨探，怎么到了云中南面来了？突厥人不是在北面吗？”
韩约回头，就见徐乐缓缓走了进来，在徐乐身侧，跟着手持单钺戟的宋宝。

隐隐火光之中，徐乐身姿挺拔，剑眉微微剔起。一脸似笑非笑的神情。
火长一怔，第一个念头就是，这不是哪个世家的子弟罢！不是世家子弟，怎么身边会有身手这般高明的护卫？
第二个念头接着就立刻翻腾而上，这世家子弟，如何带着货物，走这么一条凶险的商路？
难道是王仁恭王太守家族中的子弟？王仁恭久欲吞并恒安府鹰扬兵，麾下马邑兵也在不断北调，威慑云中。王仁恭家中子弟出而效力，化妆商队，出而查探云中府周遭虚实，也是论不定的事情！
火长脸上神色青白不定，一时间连胸口痛楚都给忘了。念头转动不定，想着是不是纳头便拜，从此换一条粗腿抱抱，省得在刘武周麾下受穷。
转瞬间狠毒之意又翻了上来，世家子弟，如何是自己得罪得起！刘鹰击是大业天子钦点回返马邑，还是被世家子王仁恭逼迫得不能立足。
这些世家子眼中，没有出身的人就如草芥一般。自己今夜偷袭，就算一时容忍，回过头来，杀自己这一队兄弟如屠鸡犬一般！就算不亲自动手，告到刘鹰击那里，现下刘鹰击也必然将他推出来，给王仁恭一个交代！
如果不是世家子弟，只是行商之人，到口的肥肉如何能吐出来？自家几个兄弟白受伤了不成？
火长偷眼打量徐乐，徐乐只是站在那儿，等着他的回答。
星月光芒之下，徐乐一副英挺斯文兼具的模样，略微偏瘦的身形虽然挺拔，却怎么也没有韩约厚重身形那种威慑力。两手更是空空，浑身上下就看不到半件兵刃。

content_en:
The fires kicked away by Xu Le were burning sporadically on the top of the mountain. The firelight shone in, making the Yingyang soldiers of the Sui Youtun Guard Heng'an Prefecture who were lying or standing in the woods look pale.
Han Yue's thick and strong figure stood solemnly, but none of the Yingyang soldiers who had seen the Turks in battle dared to step forward.
No one expected that robbing a caravan would actually kick the iron plate!
In the area east of the river, the folk customs are strong and there are many chivalrous young men. But compared to the means in the army, there is still a gap. Not to mention that Hengan Yingyang Mansion is famous for its elites, and they are not inferior in battle with the Turks.
Not to mention that they acted cautiously and waited for the caravan to fall asleep before quietly touching it.
Even if the Turkic wolves ride in a small group and change places, they may suffer losses at their hands.
But this caravan not only discovered their movements early, but also had such a terrifying person. At such a young age, dancing with iron medals is purely a military technique, and it is surprisingly clever. Even if he enters Yingyang's house in Hengan, Liu Yingqi will be reused no matter what. He is indispensable for the position of team leader in the middle camp.
What kind of business is this kind of person doing?
Thoughts were swirling in the fire chief's chest. He pressed his chest in severe pain and spoke again: "Aren't you Turkic sentries? We were ordered by Captain Liu Ying to attack Heyuan to intercept and kill the Turkic sentries in the mountains... Who are you?"
This long-lasting fire and thoughtful work are also famous in Yingyang Mansion in Hengan. When a person's mind is alive, all kinds of thoughts come to him, such as cheating and cheating to survive. In addition, he is quite selfish and only cares about military discipline. Therefore, although he is following Liu Wuzhou's old team, he has never been promoted. Now he is just a fire chief.
Just now, he was lucky enough to save his life after shouting. It seems that Ying Yangbing's identity calmed him down. The fire chief casually gave them a legitimate reason for the raid, with cold sweat dripping down his back as he used his words to scare the murderous god in front of him.
The brothers under his command also have the same temperament as him, and they don't know how many things they have done together in private to violate military discipline. As soon as Huo Chang's words changed, everyone understood and agreed together.
"You are not a Turkic sentry. You just said it. Why do you rush in to fight?"
"If our men hadn't been accurate, noticed something was wrong, and raised their hands when firing the arrow, a few of your people would have been injured!"
"We have good intentions, but you are merciless! Now we have injured a few people. Can you tell us how to calculate the score?"
Han Yue stood in the middle of the field, holding an iron plate and looking at a loss.
During the fight, Han Yue was as fierce as a mad tiger, but now that he was being squeezed by these soldiers, he really couldn't say a word. Just now these people fired arrows, and they all hit the iron mark accurately. If they hadn't been properly protected, they would be lying here now, and they didn't look like they were holding back.
But these people are the Ying Yang soldiers of Heng'an Mansion after all!
At this time, Xu Le's voice was heard, and he seemed to be smiling: "Are you really the Yingyang soldiers of Heng'an Mansion? Why did you come to the south of Yunzhong to investigate the Turkic sentries? Aren't the Turks in the north?"
Han Yue turned around and saw Xu Le slowly walking in, followed by Song Bao holding a single halberd beside Xu Le.
In the dim light of the fire, Xu Le stood tall and straight, his sword eyebrows slightly raised. A look that was half-smiling but not smiling.
Huo Chang was startled, and his first thought was, this is not a child of some aristocratic family! If he wasn't a member of a noble family, why would he have such a skilled guard around him?
The second thought immediately came to mind. How could a member of this aristocratic family carry goods through such a dangerous trade route?
Could it be that he is a descendant of Wang Rengong’s family? Wang Rengong had long wanted to annex Heng'an Prefecture, and his troops from Mayi were constantly moving north to intimidate Yunzhong. The children of Wang Rengong's family went out to serve, put on a caravan, and went out to investigate YunThe reality surrounding the Zhongfu is also a matter of uncertainty!
The fire chief's face looked pale and pale, and he even forgot about the pain in his chest for a while. My mind was wandering, thinking about whether I should just bow down and hug him with a thick leg, so as not to suffer poverty under Liu Wuzhou's command.
In an instant, the vicious intention surfaced again. How could a child from an aristocratic family afford to offend him? Liu Yingchun was personally appointed by Emperor Daye to return to Mayi, but he was forced by Wang Rengong, the son of the aristocratic family, to the point where he could not stand.
In the eyes of these aristocratic families, people without family background are like grass and grass. Even if I tolerate my sneak attack tonight, I will turn around and kill my brothers like chickens and dogs! Even if he doesn't take action himself and sue Liu Yingchong, Liu Yingchong will definitely push him out now and give Wang Rengong an explanation!
If he is not a descendant of an aristocratic family, but is just a businessman, how can he spit out the fat in his mouth? Could it be that several of my brothers were injured in vain?
The fire chief looked at Xu Le secretly, but Xu Le just stood there, waiting for his answer.
Under the light of the stars and moon, Xu Le looked handsome and elegant. Although his slightly thin figure was tall and straight, it was not as intimidating as Han Yue's thick figure. His hands were even more empty, and not a single weapon could be seen anywhere on his body.
